title: Mounted Stantler crashes when the first skid tile is blocked

verification.actor: One current mounted Stantler (species 234, party slot 0) on map 33
verification.trigger: From map 33 (584,406), hold Right until the current mounted Stantler first targets (589,406) in a completed frame (at most 32 frames). Then hold Down for 18 frames. The pending Right Walk must commit before the due skid request.
verification.observable: The first east skid tile (590,406) is blocked. No skid motion starts or commits. Crash occurs and rider and Stantler remain at (589,406) with idle control.

setupMutations.change: Copy test.nds and test.sav. Teleport to map 33 (584,406), prepare party slot 0 level-10 Stantler, mount, settle 16 neutral frames, and bind its live actor. Do not edit profile, policy, motion, facing, input, or terrain during observation.

limits: Prepared placement does not prove natural travel or acquisition. Right and Down use normal keys and unchanged Sprint timing.
This case measures a blocked first skid tile with zero skid motion. It does not prove every terrain obstacle.
Registration alone is not runtime acceptance; the checked test must pass on the current ROM.

events.value: Prepare and bind one mounted Stantler at map 33 (584,406).
Hold Right until the current Stantler first targets (589,406), within 32 completed frames; leave that Walk in flight.
Hold Down for 18 completed frames through the blocked first-skid Crash.

stop.condition: Zero skid commits, blocked first-tile Crash, and idle control at (589,406).

invariants: The bound mounted Stantler and rider stay at or before the last clear tile (589,406) in every completed frame.
No skid motion starts toward blocked (590,406).
Only clear skid tiles commit before Crash.
No logical commit follows motion cancellation.
Control returns with idle mounted input ownership at (589,406).
